transcript.text: Hello, welcome back to the On Print Shop Store Personalization tutorial series.
In this video, we'll see how you can create new content pages for your website and set links for the same.
On the front store of your website, you can find various content pages such as About Us, Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, etcetera.
Let's say that you have a Word document prepared for DTG printing technology and you want to share this piece of information with your customers through your website.
For this, you can create a new content page and share it on your website.
So let's get started.
In the admin panel, go to the Content Management section and click on the contents.
The Contents section is further categorized into Dynamic Pages, Category, and Fixed Content.
The dynamic pages are displayed at the storefront with links containing HTML content.
Any content page added by the admin is considered a dynamic page, whereas the fixed pages are displayed at the storefront using the blocks in the inner pages.
The Category tab allows you to create categories for the content pages.
Let's create a content page.
Now click on the Add button on the Add Content page.
Enter a unique key for the page that will be considered for creating the page URL.
This key will be used to create a unique URL for the page to be displayed at the front store.
Let's add DTG printing here in the URL.
You need to add the page URL making sure the name is SEO friendly and browser friendly.
Let's add DTG printing information.
Add a heading for this page that will appear at the front end such as DTG Printing technology.
In the full layout field.
Choose the page layout such that you want the header and footer content on this content page or not.

If you enable full HTML then the content will be displayed in normal view along with a header and footer and if full HTML is disabled then the content will be displayed as a stand alone page without any header, footer, sidebar etcetera.
We are creating the page with the default option here.
The next field is to display a sidebar to this page or not.
Let's skip adding a sidebar for this by selecting No sidebar here.
If you want to use this content page as a blog page as well, then enable the blog page setting in the SEO section.
You can define the description for these pages such as the title, meta descriptions, meta keywords, etcetera.
In the content section below, you can add the content and short descriptions for the page.
You can take the help of our technical team to add any blocks in the page content section such as CMS blog block or price calculator block etcetera.
We are adding the word file content here by simply copying and pasting steps with the Upload file button.
You can upload any image file to be displayed on the content page, verify all the details added and then save.
You can find the page added to the dynamic pages list.
To see how this page will appear on the front end, you can click on the eye icon against this content page.
Here you can see that the page content is displayed with the top header, header, and footer sections.
The next step is to add a link for this page on the website.
Click on the link icon for this page and it will take you to the Add menu link page with the details filled up in the All Links field.
We have set the link for the header section with some details.
To know how you can create header or footer links, you can watch the video from our help portal.
Once you have set the link, save the changes.
You can see the link added from the Links Header footer page of the Store Personalization section.
Finally, it is time to see how this content page will appear on the front store.
So let's move back to the website and refresh the page.
And here you can see that the link for DTG Printing Technology has been added in the header section.
Clicking on it will redirect to the page for more details.
And that's it.
You have successfully created a new content page and links for your website.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
